subject: front view of an adult male anime head (toon shaded, hair on) compared with the official MHS3 render of Leo, framed to the same pupil line and chin
reference_style: Monster Hunter Stories 3 official character render (Leo): semi-realistic anime, toon colours with soft painted shading, fine painted detail in eyes and hair, thin dark-brown outlines

eyes.reference: Narrow almond eye openings; the grey-white sclera is shaded grey under the upper lid; the muted green iris has a dark band across its top, fine radial lines and lighter rings, a dark pupil and two small white highlights; a heavy dark-brown upper lash line.
eyes.ours: Rounder eye openings with a large area of pure white sclera; a flat saturated green iris with a dark green rim and a dark pupil, two white highlights, no grey shading under the lid and no texture in the iris; dark upper lash line with an upturned wing.

brows.reference: Brows drawn as dark-brown brush strokes with a hatched texture, angled down toward the nose, the inner ends almost touching the lash line.
brows.ours: Brows are flat solid brown bars of even colour, nearly horizontal, sitting just above the lashes.

hair.reference: Full hair mass in broad clumps with many thin pale painted streaks and dark lines between clumps, three or more tones from dark brown to light gold.
hair.ours: Hair in chunky clumps in two flat browns with a few pale strokes on top and thin dark lines at the clump edges.

skin_shading.reference: Warm skin with soft painted shadow shapes: under the fringe, down the far side of the face and under the cheekbone, under the nose and lower lip; a broad pale highlight on the nose bridge.
skin_shading.ours: Flat peach skin with a hard-edged jagged shadow band under the fringe and a straight shadow along one side of the face; a thin pale highlight stripe on the nose; faint pink blush ovals.

outline.reference: Thin dark-brown outlines that vary a little in thickness, darker under the jaw.
outline.ours: Thin even dark-brown outline around the face.
